text_block_list.text:
After our outing, on the way back
with Daiwa Scarlet—

The two of us scrambled
underneath a nearby tree...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Jeez, this is the worst! The forecast said
it'd be cloudy, but no rain!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
We've still got a bit of a way to the academy...
I wonder when this rain will finally stop.
choice_data_list: Maybe we should just run back.
Maybe we should just run back?
Let's take shelter from the rain here.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"H-Hey!
Putting me aside, what about you—"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Aah, jeez!
Don't blame me if you catch a cold, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
—Come to think of it, isn't it strange?
Running like this in the rain with you!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
I'm somehow starting to have fun.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Come on! Hurry up, or I'm
going to leave you behind!

Afterward, the two of us ran back to the academy.
Daiwa Scarlet seemed pleased for some reason.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You're right, we can't afford to catch a cold.
I hope it stops soon, though...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...Just waiting out the rain like this
is kind of frustrating, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
......Oh, I know!
Since we're here, why don't you tell me all about yourself?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'm bored, so I suppose I don't mind hearing you out. Hehe, you'd better thank the rain.

After that, while taking shelter from the rain,
I told Daiwa Scarlet various things about myself.

She listened with great interest
until the rain stopped.
